title: where holds several places in one string
what: A queue item's where is a list of strings. Each element starts with one place as its first word, `path`, `path:N` or `path:N-M`, then an optional note for people after a space: ["lib/relay_setup.py:325-333 merge_settings", "docs/"]. The schema check refuses an element whose first word is not that shape. Q1 takes its path and line from the first element (N of N-M); the other elements go into its details. One script rewrites all records, open and done, through the queue's writer; nothing reads the old string form afterwards (no second format).
why: 25 Oct, measured: 97 records have where, 68 name several places in one string, and _q1 then makes the whole string Q1's path at line 1 (squash-merge-projects-keep-check-records-of-lost: path "lib/relay_marks.py, plugins/core/hooks/guard-main.sh (... writes), docs"). The owner asked "Почему мы не записываем его в формате списка строк" and picked "a" (a list of strings, the place as first word, a note after it) over a list of tables. Done records are rewritten too: where is a description, not a dated event. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen), right after the pilot fixes.
failing_case: _q1 on the item squash-merge-projects-keep-check-records-of-lost returns path equal to the whole where string and line 1.
pass_cases: _q1 on that item after the rewrite returns path lib/relay_marks.py; an element "lib/relay_setup.py:325-333 merge_settings" gives path lib/relay_setup.py, line 325; relay queue add refuses where = "a, b" (a string) and an element whose first word has a non-numeric line; relay queue show prints every place.
where: lib/relay_queue.py:938 _q1, lib/relay_queue.py:125 (the type check), lib/relay_queue.py:307 (show), rules/queue.md
